levels.title: Join Artist and Demo Tables
levels.task: Your manager wants to see each demo alongside the artist’s genre. Join new_artists and demo_songs using the artist’s name.
levels.successMessage: Nailed it! Now everyone can see the demos by genre.

levels.title: Join with City and State
levels.task: The team wants to organize upcoming demo sessions by city. List each demo with the artist’s city and state.
levels.successMessage: Great! Now they know where everyone’s from.

levels.title: Filter Joined Results
levels.task: Someone is requesting all Indie demos. Filter your joined results so only Indie genre songs appear.
levels.solution:
SELECT demo_songs.song_title, new_artists.genre
FROM demo_songs
JOIN new_artists ON demo_songs.artist_name = new_artists.name
WHERE new_artists.genre = 'Indie';
levels.hintMessage: Add WHERE after the JOIN to filter the final result.
levels.successMessage: Clean and filtered! Just what the team needed.

levels.title: Add Submission Dates to Joined View
levels.task: Add the submission_date column to your join so the team can schedule listening sessions in order.
levels.hintMessage: You can select columns from both tables in the same query.
levels.successMessage: Nicely done! Now everything’s sorted with dates.

levels.title: Order Joined Results by Submission Date
levels.task: For the next team meeting, order the demo list from newest to oldest. Show the title, artist, and date.
levels.solution:
SELECT demo_songs.song_title, demo_songs.artist_name, demo_songs.submission_date
FROM demo_songs
JOIN new_artists ON demo_songs.artist_name = new_artists.name
ORDER BY demo_songs.submission_date DESC;
levels.hintMessage: Use ORDER BY at the end to sort your results.
levels.successMessage: Perfect! The team will love this clean, organized list.
